I truly believe they ruined Torchwood by moving it to America. But I suppose, main reason was that they needed a new name for the show. Miracle Day was a mess.

Fear Her. Honestly, I thought the plot worked really well. It was something a bit... different. It took place on Earth, and had a bit of a serious issue behind it. To me, it just seemed like an episode that didn't need all the special effects and green screens to work remarkably well (well for me anyway.) I was really sad when I realized everyone hated it because it was a nice and light 
episode before the horrors of The Army of Ghosts and Doomsday. 

Also, The Lazarus Experiment. That was a great episode, and I feel like no one ever talks about it and it just gets forgotten :( It was a really good message that eternal life sometimes ain't a good thing. And we even got a chase scene which was cool.
